title: Marco Pierre White Barbecue Lamb Chops & Salmon
ingredients: Salt and freshly cracked black pepper
Ketchup vinaigrette: ketchup, red wine vinegar, olive oil, finely chopped shallot and chives
instructions: Preheat grill or heavy cast iron ridged grill pan over high heat.
Season lamb chops generously with salt, pepper, and a touch of olive oil.
Grill lamb chops for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare, getting deep sear marks.
Grill salmon skin-side down until crispy, about 4 minutes, then flip for 2 minutes.
Whisk ketchup, red wine vinegar, shallots, chives, and olive oil for the signature ketchup vinaigrette.
Drizzle warm vinaigrette over the rested chops and crispy salmon.
notes: Classic Marco Pierre White preparation highlighting the contrasting richness of charred lamb and salmon paired with an acidic ketchup vinaigrette.
